baselines.measure: Joe’s current weekly time spent using heavy AI sessions for routine system/business operation
baselines.next_action: Use a time diary plus interview.
baselines.bound_product_action: Prioritize the highest-time routine for a visual workflow, Doc answer, or governed action card
baselines.post_launch_comparison: Compare like-for-like weekly minutes at 30 and 90 days

baselines.measure: Count and categories of routine questions that require Claude/Codex explanation
baselines.next_action: Classify observed questions and interview recall.
baselines.bound_product_action: Add grounded visual explanation, source/freshness context, or Doc retrieval for repeated categories
baselines.post_launch_comparison: Compare count and category mix at 30 and 90 days

baselines.measure: Count and categories of recurring actions that cannot be completed visually
baselines.next_action: Run a journey inventory and partner interview.
baselines.bound_product_action: Create a straightforward governed control or intentionally classify the action as heavy engineering work
baselines.post_launch_comparison: Re-run the same journey inventory after launch

baselines.measure: Median time to determine business state and system health
baselines.next_action: Time uncoached tasks across representative days.
baselines.bound_product_action: Refine Command Center summaries, source links, freshness, and Control Room safe status until the delay cause is removed
baselines.post_launch_comparison: Repeat the same timed tasks at 30 and 90 days

baselines.measure: Number of hand-carried context transfers between sessions
baselines.next_action: Count observed manual relay events and interview examples.
baselines.bound_product_action: Add durable request context, task-to-task handoff, origin links, and returned evidence
baselines.post_launch_comparison: Compare like-for-like hand-carried transfers at 30 and 90 days

refusal.message: An unregistered legacy Front Door destination was not exposed.
